    a = acc[acc.date=='9/22/2025'].groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()
    b = acc[(acc.date>='9/15/2025')&(acc.date<='9/21/2025')].groupby([col,'date'])['unblended_cost'].sum().groupby(level=0).mean()
    d = (a-b).sort_values(ascending=False)
    return d

for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    print('===',col)
    print(diff_by(col).head(10))
